alignment_target.role: behavioral reference for the local TUI integration

local_overlay.policy: intentional product extension; upstream identity remains immutable
contracts: primary presentation writes history to native terminal scrollback
history batches are prepared, rendered, and acknowledged exactly once
completion overlays remain inside the bounded editor surface
POSIX signal restoration uses native immutable termios storage and lock-free scalar mode publication without entering the Cangjie runtime
static target-specific terminal FFI is rebuilt from source in isolated profiles and adds no runtime DSO
normal close restores original signal dispositions; raw Ctrl-C remains input; signal exits retain 128 plus signal
native terminal smoke evidence covers Linux PTY only; Windows retains its console fallback and macOS is not execution-validated
bracketed paste scanning preserves a split terminator, the next paste and following controls without rescanning the complete prefix
monotonic grapheme traversal and viewport-clipped cursor measurement preserve the complete Unicode document and byte cursor
plain undecorated editor lines retain their original source span instead of rebuilding every grapheme
captured headless scopes retire actual runner internals only; exported captures and concrete product output retain separate custody
headless bounded waits drive ordinary input/update/async completion and do not acknowledge retained consumers
manual noncapturing performance frames use actual Terminal and command runtime, preserve dirty rectangles, prepay rasters and revoke their facade before the enclosing scope retires internals
ANSI history frame batching preserves the original byte order and cursor while issuing one OutputStream write; generic backends retain their original move/write/draw contract
